payload.core_mechanism_summary: Recursive backtracking enumerates all k! tuples, computing XOR of selected edge target hashes. A tuple is valid if total XOR equals XOR of all vertex hashes, ensuring a permutation (cycle cover).
payload.rationale: Solution uses recursion to generate every possible tuple (product of 1..k choices, up to 9! ≈ 3.6e5). The XOR check efficiently tests the permutation condition. This is a textbook complete search over a small combinatorial space.
